interactions.note: The epitope of Fab30 on ß-arrestin-1 was determined from the single particle cryo-electron microscopy reconstruction of the formoterol-bound ß1AR-ß-arrestin-1-Fab30 complex in nanodiscs, at a resolution of 3.3 Å. The presence of the antibody fragment Fab30 locks arrestin into an active conformation. Fab30 is also required to provide sufficient mass for the alignment of the particles during structure determination.

The epitope of Fab30 on the ß-arrestin-1-vasopressin V2 receptor phosphopeptide (V2Rpp) complex was determined from the crystal structure of the complex, solved by molecular replacement.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.6 angstroms

Binding of the epitope-specific Fab30 to ß-arrestin-1 requires the presence of  vasopressin V2 receptor phosphopeptide (V2Rpp), as demonstrated by isolation of the ternary complex by size exclusion chromatography.

Addition of epitope-specific Fab30 to the complex of ß-arrestin-1 and phosphorylated chimeric  ß2-V2 vasopressin receptor increased the percentage of receptors in the high agonist affinity state and stabilized the receptor- ß-arrestin-1 complex.

The epitope of Fab30 on ß-arrestin-1 was determined from the single-particle cryo-EM reconstruction of the subcomplex of ß-arrestin-V2T bound by nanobody 32 and Fab30 at 4.0 Å resolution. Fab30 selectively recognizes and stabilizes the active conformation of β-arrestin 1. The subcomplex is part of a megaplex of the β2V2R–β-arr1 complex co-expressed with a prenylated GRK2 (GRK2-CAAX) bound to the high-affinity β2-adrenergic receptor (β2AR) agonist BI-167107 (BI) and stabilized by the conformationally sensitive antibody fragment Fab30. Gs protein was added to the β2V2R–β-arr1–Fab30 complex to form the megaplex along with nanobody 35 (Nb35) to stabilize the β2V2R–Gs interaction. The β2V2R is an N-terminal T4 lysozyme (T4L)-fused, modified β2AR with the first 341 residues of the β2AR combined with the last 29 amino acids of the V2R C-terminal tail (V2T0). Nanobody 32 (Nb32) was added to the megaplex to further stabilize active β-arr1 bound to the phosphorylated V2T.

The epitope of Fab30 on ß-arrestin-1 was determined from the single particle cryo-electron microscopy reconstruction of the BRIL-Neurotensin receptor type 1 (NTSR1)-ß-arrestin-1 (Arr2)-Fab30 complex, at a resolution of 4.9 Å. To form a stable complex, the wild type human NTSR1 was fused with the human 3A mutant Arr2 at its C-terminus with a three amino acid linker (GSA). Cytochrome b562 RIL domain (BRIL) was also fused to the N-terminus of the receptor to increase the complex expression. Arr2 was further stabilized by fusing Fab30 light chain, an antibody fragment used to stabilize the active form of Arr2 at its C-terminus with a 12 amino acid linker (GSAGSAGSAGSA). The construct of the fusion complex was co-expressed with His8-tagged Fab30 heavy chain and a GPCR kinase, GRK5, which phosphorylated the receptor for better arrestin binding. The arrestin mutant used, with three C-terminal hydrophobic residues mutated to alanine (3 A mutants; I386A, V387A and F388A in Arr2), is known as a pre-activated form of arrestin and showed increased binding activity to NTSR1. Additional mutations were introduced for the purpose to obtain more stable complex: V81C in Arr2 to form a disulfide bond to the residue C277 in the ICL3 of NTSR1, A279C in Arr2 and G59C in the heavy chain of antibody fragment Fab30 to form a disulfide bond.

The epitope of Fab30 on ß-arrestin-1 was determined from the single-particle cryo-EM reconstruction of the complex—iperoxo/LY2119620-liganded M2Rpp in MSP1D1E3 lipid nanodiscs, bound to βarr1 and the antibody fragment Fab30, at a resolution of 4.0 complex. To ensure homogeneous phosphorylation, a synthetic phosphopeptide (pp) derived from the C terminus of vasopressin 2 receptor (V2R) was ligated onto the C terminus of M2 muscarinic receptor (M2R), forming M2Rpp. Fab30 was included to stabilize the βarr1–V2Rpp interaction and to aid in cryo-EM particle alignment.

The epitope of scFv30 on human ß-arrestin-1 was determined from the cryo-EM reconstruction of LSD-bound 5-hydroxytryptamine 2B receptor (HTR2B) in the ß-arrestin-1-coupled state at a resolution of 3.3 Å. The truncated C terminus of phosphorylated HTR2B was fused to a constitutively active human ß-arrestin-1 with an engineered scFv30 fused to the C-tail of ß-arrestin-1. Fab P2C2 was bound to HTR2B and used as a ﬁducial marker.
